offering_description.value: The company manufactures Portland and masonry cements for the Midwest construction market. Its cements are used in concrete and masonry construction.

quotes.quote: At The Monarch Cement Company, we’re proud to produce consistent and high-quality Portland and masonry cements to serve our region.
Used in brick, block and stone masonry construction, masonry cement produced by Monarch serves as a key element of the building industry throughout the Midwest.

primary_products.value: Portland cement; Portland-limestone cement; masonry cement

quotes.quote: At The Monarch Cement Company, we’re proud to produce consistent and high-quality Portland and masonry cements to serve our region.
Monarch is proud to offer Portland-Limestone Cement (PLC) – engineered to reduce carbon emissions by approximately 10% but with all the performance and resilience you’ve come to expect.

As the world’s most widely used construction material and one of the planet’s most-consumed resources, cement forms the backbone of our modern civilization. It’s the hidden ingredient giving strength to the concrete and mortar that form our buildings, roads and everything in between.
Used in brick, block and stone masonry construction, masonry cement produced by Monarch serves as a key element of the building industry throughout the Midwest.
